LANDED. Change 1648 merged as 34759270dd on origin/main (LLM-Review +1 rebar-review-bot, Verified +1 rebar-ci-bot; plain Submit, Gerrit rebased server-side).

All four ACs re-verified against the LANDED tree at origin/main, not just the local branch:
- AC1: `grep -nE '&& *[a-z]*new=\$[a-z]*total' infra/scripts/observability.sh` -> no matches; six `-lt 0 ] && *new=0` clamps present.
- AC2: tests/scripts/test_observability_rotation_2dc7.py passes (8 tests); proven RED against the pre-fix script.
- AC3: rationale comment present at six sites (one full statement at §3, five back-references).
- AC4: test_observability_offsets_6a65.py + test_observability_exit.py pass (18 tests green together).

Box observability probe will re-materialize on its own: autodeploy.sh sees the OBS_PATHS change on its next cycle and re-runs install-observability.sh. No SSH or manual box action taken or needed.

Note for the record: change 1650 (bug junco) also edits infra/scripts/observability.sh; its agent confirmed the edits are non-overlapping, so no coordination was required beyond landing this one.
